metaDescription: Web Developer California - Looking for the best web developers in California? GrowLimo is a web developer & UI/UX developer offering custom website building services. Free audit.
subheadline: A slow, generic website costs you customers before they ever see what you sell. GrowLimo is a web developer California businesses turn to when a template site starts holding the business back. As a web development agency California companies hire for custom engineering instead of theme-based builds, and the web development company California teams trust with CRM and API integrations, we build custom web applications with React, Next.js, and Node.js for companies across Los Angeles, San Diego, and San Francisco, rather than reselling plugins and pre-made themes.

faqs.question: Which programming languages and frameworks do you use?
faqs.answer: Primarily React, Next.js, Node.js, and TypeScript, chosen for performance, type safety, and long-term maintainability over legacy CMS plugin stacks.

faqs.question: Will the custom application pass Google's Core Web Vitals?
faqs.answer: Yes. Every build is engineered against Core Web Vitals thresholds from the start, using headless architecture, code-splitting, and CDN deployment rather than optimizing after the fact.

faqs.question: Can you integrate our custom CRM or database system?
faqs.answer: Yes. We build secure API connections to CRM, billing, inventory, and practice management systems, with automated testing and error-handling pipelines to keep integrations reliable after launch.

faqs.question: Can you fix a slow website built by another developer?
faqs.answer: Yes. Technical site speed audits identify slow database queries, bloated scripts, and unoptimized assets, with a clear remediation plan before any rebuild decision is made.

faqs.question: Do you offer UI/UX design services as part of a build?
faqs.answer: Yes. Design and engineering are handled by the same team through one process, from user research and wireframing through prototyping and accessibility-first design.

faqs.question: Will we own the custom source code after launch?
faqs.answer: Yes. Clients retain ownership of the custom source code built for their project.

faqs.question: Do you require a long-term contract?
faqs.answer: No. GrowLimo operates without long-term lock-in contracts on web development engagements.
